answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 4609 Country: Pakistan Title: Assala mu Alikum i am student of university there is co education there man attract with female very rare chance to save imman what should i do plz tell me some zakir to save from it jazakumullaha khair Question: Assala mu Alikum i am student of university there is co education there man attract with female very rare chance to save imman what should i do plz tell me some zakir to save from it jazakumullaha khair Answer ID: 4609 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa487/487=D-1429) You should busy yourself with your studies and shun always from seeing non-mahram girls. You had better keep on reciting this dua: اللهم اني اعوذبك من فتنة النساء and the third kalimah ( سبحان اللہ والحمد للہ ۔۔۔۔۔۔ ). Also, recite the below dua in loneliness while concentrating on its meaning and seek Allah's help: اللهم اني اسئلك خشيتک ما تحول به بيني وبين معاصیك Oh' Allah! Grant me your fear which prevents me from committing your disobedience. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
